node.statement: Row-far dual certificate: for an exact signed idempotent P and a geometrically distinct row vertex v with delta(P) > 0 (tau = sqrt(delta), rho = 4*tau), writing L_F(v) = sum over {f : ||p_f - p_v||_1 >= rho} of max(P_vf, 0) and nu_v the row negative mass, if L_F(v) > 0 then t*(v) <= nu_v / L_F(v), where t*(v) is the exposedness margin of def-exposed.
